description: Find feature flags that are declared but appear nowhere in the source, and deliver a removal plan. During flag cleanup, when you have the flag list and the source. Do not choose this when flags are resolved dynamically, which a textual check cannot follow. Example requests: Which feature flags can I delete? | Find dead feature flags in this source tree. | Audit my flags and tell me what is safe to remove.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

flags.description: The customer's flags.json, as text. Supported: JSON array, or one flag name per line. The declared flag names. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

source.description: The customer's source.txt, as text. Supported: Any source text. The source tree to search. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_feature_flag_audit
title: Feature flag debt audit
